configuration.scheduler: Commerce scheduling not enabled; no expiry/reconciliation jobs running.
configuration.databasePool: Hikari datasource present; pool utilization and connection timings are not instrumented or measured.
configuration.schedule: closed loop; four fixed GETs in order per worker; no retry

warmup.cacheState: uncontrolled; no flush or cold-cache claim

configuration.measurementWindow: After refund integration suite finished; root paused Maven and requested frontend author hold E2E/unit/build. Frontend author subsequently reported a focused Vitest run had already started before the hold notice, so overlap during these 160 requests is possible. Spring devtools, Vite and IDE remained running on the same laptop. This was not a confirmed quiet window; contention was uncontrolled.

dataset.note: Persistent isolated TV3 demo database: three furniture SKUs and retained cancelled E2E orders; no production data.

statistics.percentileMethod: nearest rank; all attempted requests including failures
statistics.latencyScope: client wall time including HTTP connection/read/JSON; excludes think time
statistics.throughputScope: count / shared measured wall seconds; includes think/scheduling
statistics.setupExcluded: runtime checks, logins, dataset snapshots and warmup

limitations: Small existing isolated dataset; not production capacity evidence.
No business writes, provider calls, Redis test, SQL timing or pool telemetry.
Session login is the only POST; separate cookie jars per worker and role.
